---
title: "MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia si3d: RNA-only and ribo-only results, and translation categories"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  condition: "hypoxia"
---

**Why this exists.** MDA-MB-231's TE results carry a `category` column (Forwarded / Exclusive /
Buffered / TE_only, from `categorize_translation_changes()` in `code/functions.R`). The saved
MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia si3d result (`2024_eIF3e_hypoxia/counts/hypoxia_si_ctrl_3d.csv`) is the TE
interaction term only, with no RNA-only or ribo-only contrast, so it cannot be categorized.
This notebook fits those two contrasts on the same samples and counts, then categorizes.

**Category definitions** (from `categorize_translation_changes()`; "sig" = padj < 0.05, and
as at every call site in this project `lfc_cutoff = 0`, so significance alone):

| category | RNA sig | ribo sig | TE sig |
|---|---|---|---|
| Exclusive | no | yes | yes |
| TE_only | no | no | yes |
| Buffered | yes | either | yes |
| Forwarded | yes | yes | no |
| Not_sig | otherwise | | |

**How the fits match the original.** Same count matrix
(`counts/calculate_te/raw_filtered_allCounts.csv`), same 12 samples (hypoxia sictrl + si3d,
reps a-c, RNA + ribo), same `sictrl` reference, `cooksCutoff = FALSE`,
`independentFiltering = FALSE`, no spike-ins, as in `5_hypoxicresponse.Rmd` ("si3d vs sictrl in
hypoxia"). The TE fit is re-run and its padj asserted against the saved file before the new
contrasts are trusted. RNA-only and ribo-only use `~ treatment` on their own library type.

**Condition** (`params$condition`, added 2026-11-20): `"hypoxia"` (default, the original run) or
`"normoxia"`, which reproduces the saved `normoxia_sictrl_3d.csv` (fit in `3_normoxia.Rmd` on the
same count matrix). Output: `mcf7six1_{condition}_1hr_si3d_rna_ribo_te_categories.csv`.

**`rna_lfc_shrunk`** is the RNA LFC after apeglm shrinkage, matching how every TE file and the
MDA-MB-231 `rna_lfc` are reported; use it for plots and rankings by size, where unshrunk
low-count genes scatter widely. `rna_lfc` itself stays unshrunk, as before.

Raw MCF7-SIX1 LFCs are log2(si3d / sictrl); every LFC here is **negated** so positive = eIF3d
promotes, matching MDA-MB-231 and this repo's MCF7-SIX1 TE file.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(DESeq2)
})
source(here("code", "functions.R"))
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) params <- list(condition = "hypoxia")
stopifnot(params$condition %in% c("hypoxia", "normoxia"))
saved_file <- c(hypoxia = "hypoxia_si_ctrl_3d.csv", normoxia = "normoxia_sictrl_3d.csv")[[params$condition]]
mcf_repo <- "/Users/katematlin/github/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia"
out_dir  <- here("output", "finding_positive_controls")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r data}
meta <- read_csv(file.path(mcf_repo, "counts/calculate_te/metadata.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(condition == params$condition, treatment %in% c("sictrl", "si3d")) %>%
  mutate(name      = paste(condition, treatment, rep, library, sep = "_"),
         treatment = relevel(factor(treatment), ref = "sictrl"),
         library   = relevel(factor(library),   ref = "rna"))
stopifnot(nrow(meta) == 12, all(table(meta$treatment, meta$library) == 3))

counts <- read_csv(file.path(mcf_repo, "counts/calculate_te/raw_filtered_allCounts.csv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()
stopifnot(all(meta$name %in% colnames(counts)))
counts <- counts[, meta$name]
```

```{r fits, message=FALSE}
fit <- function(cols, design, coef_idx, shrink = FALSE) {
  m   <- meta %>% filter(name %in% cols)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts[, m$name], colData = m, design = design)
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
  nm  <- resultsNames(dds)[coef_idx]
  cat("coefficient:", nm, "\n")
  res <- results(dds, name = nm, cooksCutoff = FALSE, independentFiltering = FALSE)
  out <- res %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
    transmute(gene_id, lfc = -log2FoldChange, padj)   # negate: promotes-positive
  if (shrink) {
    sh <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = nm, res = res, type = "apeglm", quiet = TRUE)
    stopifnot(identical(rownames(sh), out$gene_id))
    out$lfc_shrunk <- -sh$log2FoldChange
  }
  out
}

te   <- fit(meta$name, ~ treatment + library + treatment:library, 4)
rna  <- fit(meta$name[meta$library == "rna"],  ~ treatment, 2, shrink = TRUE)
ribo <- fit(meta$name[meta$library == "ribo"], ~ treatment, 2)
```

### Reproduction and direction checks

```{r checks}
saved <- read_csv(file.path(mcf_repo, "counts", saved_file), show_col_types = FALSE)
chk <- inner_join(saved, te, by = "gene_id")
cat("TE genes: saved", nrow(saved), "| refit", nrow(te), "| shared", nrow(chk), "\n")
cat("max |padj difference| vs saved TE:", signif(max(abs(chk$padj.x - chk$padj.y)), 3), "\n")
stopifnot("refit TE does not reproduce the saved MCF7-SIX1 TE padj" =
            nrow(chk) == nrow(saved), max(abs(chk$padj.x - chk$padj.y)) < 1e-8)

e <- function(df) df$lfc[df$gene_id == saved$gene_id[saved$symbol == "EIF3D"]]
cat(sprintf("EIF3D (promotes-positive): rna %.2f, ribo %.2f, te %.2f\n", e(rna), e(ribo), e(te)))
stopifnot("direction flipped: EIF3D RNA should fall on si3d (positive after negation)" = e(rna) > 1)
```

### Categorize

```{r categorize}
to_res <- function(df) df %>% transmute(gene_id, log2FoldChange = lfc, padj)
cats <- categorize_translation_changes(to_res(rna), to_res(ribo), to_res(te),
                                       padj_cutoff = 0.05, lfc_cutoff = 0.0)$categorized_table

out <- cats %>%
  left_join(rna  %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, rna_padj  = padj, rna_lfc_shrunk = lfc_shrunk), by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(ribo %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, ribo_padj = padj), by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(te   %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, te_padj   = padj), by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(saved %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, symbol), by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(category = as.character(category))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(out$gene_id))
dplyr::count(out, category) %>% knitr::kable()

write_csv(out, file.path(out_dir, paste0("mcf7six1_", params$condition, "_1hr_si3d_rna_ribo_te_categories.csv")))
```
